## About Me

Hello! My name is Sophia Saxton. I am currently studying Psychology, Statistics and Data Science and Gender and Sexuality Studies at St. Olaf College. My interests include Biostatistics, Public Health, and Epidemiology.

Outside of school, I compete on the varsity volleyball team, work at the campus libraries, and crochet in my free time.
